newsitem.title: USA: Wisconsin unemployment rises to 3.6 pct in June.
newsitem.headline: Wisconsin unemployment rises to 3.6 pct in June.

text.p: Wisconsin's seasonally adjusted unemployment rate rose to 3.6 percent in June from 3.4 percent in May, the state Workforce Development Department reported Tuesday.
Seasonally adjusted employment is at an all-time high in Wisconsin as well and the June unemployment rate ran slightly higher than the 3.5 percent reported a year ago, the department reported.
Nonfarm employment rose about 33,700 jobs in June over May and reflected an increase of 48,200 jobs over a year ago, the department reported.
The national seasonally adjusted unemployment rate was 5 percent in June, up from 4.8 percent in May and down from 5.3 percent reported a year ago.
